---
title: "About"
---

This site contains practicals and class examples from various courses.

The [BI1296 Practical](bi1296_practical.qmd) takes a look at how to use Galaxy with some simulated shiitake mushroom data.

The [OrthoVenn3 example](class_example_orthovenn.qmd) takes look at previously compiled orthology analyses to characterise a random sequence using only the principles of form=function

The [Phytozome example](class_example_phytozome.qmd) takes a sequence name from a paper, and takes you through obtaining the sequence from Phytozome and functionally characterising the sequence.
